programme.desc: This outrageous comedy concerns selfish Tucker Max (Matt Czuchry), who convinces his soon-to-be-married best friend Dan (Geoff Stults) to visit a famous strip joint for one last adventure. Directed by Bob Gosse.

programme.title: Billionaire Boys Club
programme.desc: In early 1980's Los Angeles, rich boys led by Joe Hunt hit it big with a Ponzi scheme. Things go horribly wrong for all involved when they learn they've been betrayed by their investor, high roller Ron Levin, leaving Hunt owing a lot of money to a lot of people.

programme.title: Loudmouth
programme.desc: A documentary that focuses on the life of Reverend Al Sharpton. Sharpton has spent the majority of his life fighting for racial equality and standing up against injustice. Most of his opposition has tried to slow him down and silence his message, but Sharpton always finds a way to tell his story.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse

programme.title: The Land
programme.desc: Four teenagers living in inner-city Cleveland discover a large stash of pills while stealing cars. When they decide to sell the drugs themselves, they are targeted by an organic-food proprietor who's secretly a local crime boss.

programme.title: The Salvation
programme.desc: A Danish immigrant in the Old West seeks revenge for the murder of his wife and son, incurring the wrath of a ruthless outlaw who terrorises a dusty town in a bid to settle the score.

programme.title: Face Off
programme.desc: An FBI agent and a terrorist trade identities after they surgically swap faces.

programme.title: The Saint

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: A teenager learns the hard way about prison life after being lock up for a minor crime.

programme.title: American Psycho
programme.desc: A rich Wall Street player basks in his late-1980s yuppie lifestyle, but behind his slick appearance lurks a murderous monster.

programme.title: American Psycho 2

Diane Lane and Mickey Rourke star. Thomas Jane, Rosario Dawson, Joseph Gordon-Levitt. Directed by John Madden.

programme.desc: In the late nineteenth century, the Russian schooner Demeter embarks on an unusual quest, carrying twenty-four unmarked crates from Carpathia to London. Their voyage seems doomed from the start, given their suspicious orders, as a malevolent presence preys upon each member of the crew. When the ship arrives, at last, in Whitby Harbour, the crew is nowhere to be found. The story is based on a chapter from Bram Stoker's Dracula.
